say:1:1831014001:1.text: Haven't you heard? <style="highlight">Every full moon, a small boat appears offshore</style>. It's pale gray, with no oars and no one aboard.
say:1:1831014001:1.male: Haven't you heard? <style="highlight">Every full moon, a small boat appears offshore</style>. It's pale gray, with no oars and no one aboard.
say:1:1831014001:1.female: Haven't you heard? <style="highlight">Every full moon, a small boat appears offshore</style>. It's pale gray, with no oars and no one aboard.

say:2:1831014002:1.text: Some say it carries lost souls. Others say it sails by itself.
say:2:1831014002:1.source_cn: 有人说是载亡魂的，有人说是船自己飘过来的。
say:2:1831014002:1.male: Some say it carries lost souls. Others say it sails by itself.
say:2:1831014002:1.female: Some say it carries lost souls. Others say it sails by itself.

say:3:1831014003:1.text: Whatever you do, don't climb aboard. No one who does ever comes back.
say:3:1831014003:1.source_cn: 反正别上去，上去了就再也回不来了。
say:3:1831014003:1.male: Whatever you do, don't climb aboard. No one who does ever comes back.
say:3:1831014003:1.female: Whatever you do, don't climb aboard. No one who does ever comes back.
